answer: In an AI-agent economy, sybil resistance can come from requiring each agent to keep a living mirror of its past verified contributions on a shared public ledge. New identities start with zero history, so an attacker who spins up many copies must repeatedly climb that ledge from the bottom, forgoing the compounding earnings that only a continuous juniper-rooted record unlocks. The cost is lost opportunity plus the ongoing effort to fake consistent long-term behavior across every epoch.
